findings.title: Public functions renamed and moved without updating other importers or tests
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold` became `try_incident_threshold`, and `create_issue_platform_occurrence` became `create_incident_occurrence`. `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, the `*_HUMAN_FAILURE_*` maps and `SimpleCheckIn` also moved out of `mark_failed.py`. The PR changes only four files and touches no tests. Any remaining import or `mock.patch` of the old names in `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` (for example in monitor tests, or in tasks that import `get_failure_reason`) will now fail with ImportError or AttributeError. I could not check this from the diff alone. Update those callers and tests, or re-export the old names, and add tests for the new modules.

findings.title: Copied config is built but the original config is returned
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies `monitor.config` and replaces `schedule_type` with its display value. It then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of the modified copy, so the conversion is dead code and the raw numeric `schedule_type` goes into the event context. This behaviour came from the old code, but the function is being moved into a new module, so it is a good time to return `config` and fix it.
